C0499.title: Exploiting Ordering Loophole via Proxy Purchasing to Illegally Profit Over One Million Yuan
keywords: illegally obtaining computer information system data
C0499.summary: Starting May 2024, suspect Wang discovered a vulnerability in a fast-food company's mini-program that allowed converting coupon codes into product redemption codes. Wang opened an online store, listing virtual goods under the guise of proxy purchasing and coupon codes, providing buyers with electronic redemption codes to complete orders below the store's selling price.
